reviewMethod.method: Read all implementation/test deltas; read relevant business/framework copy and six language briefs; evaluate the exact localized numeric sentences; compare both Japanese article prose and displayed Rust programs with immutable baseline bytes; verify every candidate signature and prior independent report digest; retain unchanged topic scores and recorded minor observations after proving the input closure differs only in the reviewed shared change.
reviewMethod.independence: This reviewer identified the original search and Japanese-copy defects and did not author or apply the fixes. This file records actual incremental review, not automated replacement of hashes.
reviewMethod.exclusions: No claim that all unchanged longform translations were reread. No final browser, build, deployment, machine-reading or usage acceptance is granted by this source report.
reviewMethod.scorePolicy: Retain independently assigned per-topic scores for unchanged text. The reviewed delta introduces no new terminology, syntax or register deficiency and improves numeric/search/copy usability; prior minor observations are not silently closed.
